title: No Orphan Tool Calls — Stop-Path Error Propagation
scope: Map how OpenWorker ensures every pending tool_call gets a tool error result in history when the turn is interrupted, denied, or stopped — preventing orphaned tool_calls that confuse the LLM.

interrupted_tool.behavior: Called when stop is requested mid-tool-execution. Appends _tool_error_message(tool_call, 'interrupted by user') to history — role='tool' with json.dumps({'error': 'tool call not executed', 'reason': 'interrupted by user'})
interrupted_tool.purpose: Orphaned tool_calls (assistant emitted a tool_call but no result) are rejected by hosted chat templates and cause durable-resume re-prompting. Every pending call must get an answer.

cancel_integration.behavior: Sets self._cancel = asyncio.Event, runs all interrupt_hooks (shell executor kill, etc.)
cancel_integration.loop_check: _loop() checks self._cancel.is_set() at 4 points: before new iteration (line 389, mid-stream), between iterations (line 429), before each tool_call in _handle_tool_calls (line 592), and in the stream producer (line 555)

stop_path.mid_stream: engine.py:389-395 — if cancel set and turn is None: persist partial via _partial_turn(), append notice('interrupted'), emit INTERRUPTED, return
stop_path.post_tool: engine.py:429-432 — if cancel set after tool execution: append notice('interrupted'), emit INTERRUPTED, return
stop_path.in_tool: engine.py:592-595 — if cancel set during _handle_tool_calls: each remaining tool_call gets _interrupted_tool()
stop_path.in_stream: engine.py:555 — producer thread checks cancel flag, breaks stream between chunks

denied_and_unknown.denied: engine.py:757-766 — denied/unknown tool calls: _tool_error_message appended to history, TOOL_FINISHED event with status='denied'/'error'
denied_and_unknown.unknown: engine.py:758-759 — spec is None → reason='unknown tool: {name}', error appended, denied event emitted
denied_and_unknown.orphan_prevention: Every path — authorized, denied, unknown, interrupted — results in a tool_result_message in history

partial_turn_survival.behavior: What the user watched arrive — text and thinking, NO tool calls (half-formed calls would either orphan or execute against the stop)
partial_turn_survival.persistence: Appended as a complete assistant message on the error/interrupted path (engine.py:378, 393) so the transcript survives even when the turn crashes

ai_factory_existing.behavior: Walks FORWARD past a leading ToolReturnPart during compaction (lines 620-636) so a churned orphan tool-return doesn't trigger a 400 API reject on the next request
ai_factory_existing.limitation: Confined to the compaction boundary only — does NOT fire on live stop/deny/interrupt exit paths

gap_vs_ai_factory.ai_factory_existing: factory/infra/_loopguard.py:614 — get_safe_recent_messages (lines 620-636) skips a leading ToolReturnPart during compaction so a churned orphan tool-return doesn't trigger a 400. This is ai-factory's ONLY orphan-tool prevention, confined to the compaction boundary.
gap_vs_ai_factory.recovery_no_injection: factory/infra/_loopguard.py:390 (UsageLimitExceeded → recovery_agent.run at :409 passes current_history with no ToolError injection for orphaned calls); factory/infra/_loopguard.py:557 (stall/repeat → recovery_agent.run at :582 passes res.all_messages() with no ToolError injection); factory/infra/_loopguard.py:434 (generic Exception → dump+re-raise at :436, no injection)
gap_vs_ai_factory.guard_no_injection: factory/infra/tools_guard.py:160 — GuardToolset.call_tool raises RuntimeError after 3 blocked modify-tool attempts without injecting ToolError; :177 returns a plain warning string for unknown tools instead of a visible ToolError

proposal: ai-factory's GuardToolset does not guarantee that interrupted/denied tool calls get error messages injected back into the LLM conversation history. When the LLM is interrupted mid-turn (e.g. by a circuit breaker or context limit), pending tool_calls become orphans in the history — the LLM sees tool_calls with no results and either hallucinates results or gets confused on retry. OpenWorker's _interrupted_tool() + stop-path pattern ensures every tool_call — authorized, denied, unknown, or interrupted — gets a visible error message in history. This must be adopted so the LLM never operates on orphaned tool_call state.

pydantic_ai_2_impl.pattern: BeforeModelRequest hook checks for orphaned tool_calls and injects ToolError for any pending call without a result — ensures the LLM always sees a complete conversation history with no dangling references.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.why_now: ai-factory's LLMs get confused on retry when tool_calls in the history have no corresponding results — the model sees dangling references and either hallucinates fake results or refuses to act. OpenWorker's engine.py:651-662 (_interrupted_tool) proves that appending _tool_error_message for EVERY pending call on stop/cancel/deny/unknown prevents this corruption. This is the kimi-cli KC-01 gap: no output-boundary ground-truth guard for the conversation state.
pydantic_ai_2_impl.harness_gap: ai-factory's ONLY orphan-tool prevention is at factory/infra/_loopguard.py:614 — get_safe_recent_messages (lines 620-636) skips a leading ToolReturnPart during compaction so a churned tool-return doesn't trigger a 400. But the live stop/deny/interrupt exit paths do NOT inject ToolError for orphaned tool_calls: factory/infra/_loopguard.py:390 (UsageLimitExceeded recovery at :409 passes current_history with no ToolError injection), factory/infra/_loopguard.py:557 (stall/repeat recovery at :582 passes res.all_messages() with no ToolError injection), factory/infra/_loopguard.py:434 (generic Exception at :436 just dump+re-raise, no injection), and factory/infra/tools_guard.py:160 (GuardToolset.call_tool raises RuntimeError) / :177 (unknown tool returns plain warning string) — none inject a visible ToolError into conversation history. OpenWorker's _interrupted_tool (engine.py:651) pattern must be adopted: inject ToolError(json.dumps({'error':'tool call not executed','reason':'interrupted'})) for every pending tool_call on ALL exit paths — stop/cancel/deny/unknown — surfaced as visible messages triggering ModelRetry.
